topic: A shop on a dark street sells watches that show how much time each customer has left.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Shop of Remaining Seconds

shots.narration: That watch showed exactly how many seconds I had left.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated Pakistani haveli courtyard at night; Bashir in his brown shawl and white cap sits beside Saad in a dark green hoodie, brass lantern between them; no writing.
shots.action: Bashir presents a watch with a thin glowing crescent around its blank face.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, warm lantern glow, deep shadows beneath worried eyes.

shots.narration: I bought it from a shop nobody remembered seeing.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard storytelling circle beside an old carved wooden doorway; the watch rests between Bashir and Saad.
shots.mood: Still night air, faint ground fog, isolated amber light.

shots.narration: [whispers] Inside, every watch had a shrinking circle of light.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, story flashback inside a tiny watch shop on an empty Pakistani lane; unmarked watches fill dusty velvet trays; no shopkeeper, numbers, lettering or signs.
shots.action: The glowing rings around the watch faces steadily shrink.
shots.mood: Dusty blue moonlight, brass reflections, narrow pools of lantern light.

shots.narration: There was no shopkeeper, only a bowl for coins.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, empty watch shop counter with a plain brass coin bowl and one watch on a velvet cushion.
shots.action: Bashir drops an unmarked coin into the bowl.
shots.mood: Heavy darkness behind the counter, unnatural stillness.

shots.narration: The moment I wore mine, its light began disappearing.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of Bashir's wrist above the dusty counter; the watch has a blank face bordered by a glowing ring.
shots.action: The watch's glowing ring contracts into a short arc.
shots.mood: Pale light across trembling fingers, deep surrounding shadow.

shots.narration: [surprised] Then the doorway started getting smaller.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, watch shop interior facing the open doorway and foggy lane beyond; Bashir stands in the foreground.
shots.action: The doorway narrows as its wooden sides slide inward.
shots.mood: Cramped perspective, moonlit exit squeezed between black walls.

shots.narration: Each fading second took another piece of my way out.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, narrow shop exit beyond Bashir's raised wrist; only a tiny luminous crescent remains on the watch.
shots.action: The remaining crescent dwindles to a glowing point.
shots.mood: A single cold spark, oppressive walls, distant street fog.

shots.narration: I squeezed outside before the final spark vanished.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, exterior of the shrinking shop entrance on an empty old Pakistani street.
shots.action: Bashir squeezes sideways through the narrow doorway.
shots.mood: Sharp moonlight, tangled shadows, lantern glow against rough plaster.

shots.narration: [sighs] Behind me, the shop became a solid brick wall.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, deserted lane behind Bashir; the shop entrance occupies a small section of an otherwise bare brick wall.
shots.action: The entrance seals into uninterrupted brickwork.
shots.mood: Silent relief beneath cold blue moonlight.

shots.narration: But tonight, its light has started shrinking again.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, return to the haveli courtyard; Bashir and Saad sit beside the brass lantern with the watch between them.
shots.action: The watch's renewed glowing ring rapidly contracts.
shots.mood: Warm lantern light surrounded by dense, watchful darkness.

shots.narration: It wasn't counting my life, but my time outside.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide courtyard view; Bashir and Saad sit in the foreground, with a solid wall directly behind them.
shots.action: The wall opens into the same watch shop, its glowing watches stretching into impossible darkness.
shots.mood: Towering black doorway, cold watchlight swallowing the lantern glow.

shots.narration: [whispers] Tomorrow, I'll tell you why the railway clocks run backward.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, an abandoned Pakistani railway platform in moonlit fog; a large blank clock face has plain hands and no numbers, markings or lettering.
shots.mood: Empty tracks, pale fog, a distant amber lamp beneath a dark roof.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, Bashir reveals why the abandoned railway station's clocks run backward.
episode.description: By lantern light, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about a watch shop on an empty Pakistani street. Its watches didn't tell the time—they showed how much time a customer had left. A fictional spooky story.
